loop_shapes.name: Probe Campaign
loop_shapes.problem: Complex-class work where the right path is not knowable up front.
loop_shapes.forces: Need for forward progress vs. risk of committing to one unproven path.
loop_shapes.solution: Launch two or three safe-to-fail probes in parallel, then converge or pivot.
loop_shapes.consequences: Costs parallel effort; surfaces the viable path faster than serial guessing.
